impact.note: Immaterial, borderline (EV just under $1/share). Taken at face value a quantified >= 1pt lever adds ~$158M of FY27 revenue; launch opex on the FY25 pattern ($200-250M = 1.7-2.0pp) nets FY27 margin to about -0.3pp and FY27 EPS to ~0 (range -0.10 to +0.09); the stock channel is the multiple-growth slope, 1pt of FY27 nights ~ $4.90 (joint solve; $1.50 at a fixed multiple, EV $0.2). Keep one clause in the memo: management may name a 2027 lever but has never put a forward number on one.
